comparison.objective: Rearrange rack contents so frequently used items occupy the accessible middle shelf.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick, transport, and stably place three household objects on different shelf levels.
comparison.success_condition: Mug and tea tin are on the middle shelf; rarely used cake tin is on the top or bottom shelf, within pose and stillness tolerances.
comparison.reason: Semantic storage planning and object relocation do not test mechanical unlocking, adjustment, relocking, or dynamic commissioning.
